name: LayerSlider
couldBuild: A responsive slider with transitions and per-layer animation. CSS and the Web Animations API do most of the work now that jQuery-era hacks are gone.
stillMissing: The slider is not the product; the visual timeline editor is, and so are the several hundred ready-made templates. Both are large, unglamorous surfaces that take a long time and are boring to rebuild.
requirements: Responsive slider with per-layer positioning and timing
A visual editor for keyframes and transitions
Template library covering common hero and gallery layouts
Import/export so slides move between sites

alternatives.name: CSS scroll snap + a few keyframes
alternatives.desc: Modern CSS covers most hero sliders with no plugin at all.

alternatives.name: Smart Slider 3
alternatives.desc: A capable free tier if you need an editor rather than hand-written CSS.

notes: Premium-only — not on wordpress.org, so the live count is the paid product.
